messages:
maya.cs: Quick sync — VastHealth flagged a mismatch between our SLO dashboard and their internal logs. They see 99.2% uptime for onboarding flows; our billing shows 99.7%. They're asking if they qualify for onboarding latency credits and whether that impacts an upcoming renewal grace.
sam-ae: Noted. Renewal call Friday — we need a clear answer before then. What's the window for the delta?
tom.onboard: I pulled their onboarding flow metrics. Spike is concentrated in a 48h window during their dataset migration. We incurred higher tail latency from suboptimal batching + a routing fallback to CPU model for some shards.
lina-sre: Could be the routing fallback TTL didn't clear after the incident. Can you paste the query you used?
maya.cs: here's the one I used to approximate p95/p99 over 7d:
```sql
SELECT
  customer_id,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms,
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99_ms,
  count(*) AS reqs
FROM inference_logs
WHERE customer_id = 'vasthealth' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
tom.onboard: I also ran a raw head-sample for that 48h slice — p99 ≈ 710ms. Our onboarding SLO threshold is 600ms.
lina-sre: Ok. @ops-bot can you check whether the auto-crediting pipeline ran for VastHealth in the last 24h?
ops-bot: auto-credit-run: job_id=ac-20240318-78 status=completed
affected_customers=18
vasthealth=skipped (reason=delayed-rollup)
link=https://internal.ops/redwood/credits/ac-20240318-78
maya.cs: Skipped due to delayed-rollup — that explains why billing hasn't issued a credit yet.
sam-ae: What's the root cause of the delayed rollup? If it's our pipeline lag we should expedite a manual credit and prep a comms note.
lina-sre: There was a timing regression in rollup-worker v2.1.3 — it OOMed on high-cardinality day windows and delayed finalization. Recommend hotfix + targeted re-run for affected customers.
tom.onboard: Proposed plan:
1) run targeted rollup for VastHealth
2) if p99 > 600ms, issue onboarding credit per table 3 of the onboarding SLA
3) update onboarding health dashboard and flag renewal risk if credits exceed threshold
maya.cs: I'll draft the customer note once we have numbers. Also capture feedback: they contacted us because their monitoring alerted first — add "customer-side monitoring timestamp" to our evidence bundle.
lina-sre: I'll run the rollup now and post logs. est ~30m. tagging @tom.onboard
ops-bot: rollup-triggered: job=manual-rollup-2410109999-targeted user=lina-sre
target=customer:vasthealth
lina-sre: rollup done. results:
- p95=420ms
- p99=725ms
- total_reqs=12,450
- credits_calculated=$1,250
link: https://internal.ops/redwood/rollups/vasthealth/2410109999
tom.onboard: Confirmed. p99 > 600ms so credit applies per onboarding SLA table. I'll create manual credit invoice and tag billing.
maya.cs: Good. Next steps: @sam-ae do you want a pre-call to prep renewal comms? We should be transparent, explain mitigation, and offer a walkthrough.
sam-ae: Yes — please include suggested fixes (batching tweak + routing TTL change) and a one-pager on how credits were computed.
maya.cs: Will do. @lina-sre please add the "delayed-rollup" tag to the postmortem and set eng-runtime as owner.
lina-sre: done. opened ENG ticket ENG-4578 and attached logs.
maya.cs: Thanks everyone. I'll queue the invoice and send the customer note after billing confirms. :thumbsup:
